egypt_unselected_primary_k6.label: Egypt strictly unselected cohorts reporting carbapenem R (k=6, N=551; excludes Seleim 2022 [NR], Ghaith 2017 [MDR outbreak], and 4 CRAB-preselected)

egypt_unselected_sensitivity_abozahra_im.label: Sensitivity: Egypt unselected (k=6, N=551) using Abozahra 2021 imipenem-specific 88.0% instead of 91.7% ertapenem-inclusive CRAB

egypt_unselected_sensitivity_elkholy_abs.label: Sensitivity: Egypt unselected (k=6, N=551) using Elkholy 2012 Abstract 85.0% instead of Results 76.9%

egypt_unselected_icu_confirmed_only_k5.label: Sensitivity: Egypt confirmed 100%-ICU unselected cohorts only (k=5, N=501; excludes Benmahmod 2019 where hospital units were NS)

egypt_non_crab_preselected_incl_ghaith_k.label: Sensitivity: Egypt all non-CRAB-preselected cohorts incl. Ghaith 2017 (k=7, N=601; CRAB was NOT an inclusion criterion in Ghaith 2017)

mena_strict_unselected_k2.label: MENA strictly unselected cohorts reporting carbapenem R (k=2: Ballouz 2017 [82/90] + Itani 2023 [105/111], N=201)

mena_all_reporting_incl_mdr_k4_boral172.label: MENA all cohorts reporting carbapenem R incl. MDR-enrolled Boral 2019 (N=172 incl. 12 env) & Hafiz 2023 (~98%) (k=4, N=488; excludes Alotaibi 2021 [NR])

mena_all_reporting_incl_mdr_k4_boral160_.label: Sensitivity: MENA reporting carbapenem R excluding Boral 2019 12 environmental isolates (Boral clinical N=160, conservative 159/160) (k=4, N=476)

mena_exact_denominators_excl_hafiz_appro.label: Sensitivity: MENA reporting exact counts/denominators excluding Hafiz 2023 approximate '~98%' (k=3: Ballouz, Boral, Itani; N=373)

combined_strict_unselected_k8.label: Combined Egypt + MENA strictly unselected surveillance cohorts (k=8: 6 Egypt + 2 MENA [Ballouz, Itani], N=752)

combined_non_crab_preselected_excl_ghait.label: Combined non-CRAB-preselected cohorts excluding Ghaith 2017 (k=10: 6 Egypt + 4 MENA [Boral N=172], N=1,039)
Sensitivity: Combined non-CRAB-preselected excluding Ghaith 2017 & Boral 12 env isolates (k=10, N=1,027)

combined_all_non_crab_preselected_incl_g.label: Combined all non-CRAB-preselected cohorts including Ghaith 2017 & Boral N=172 (k=11: 7 Egypt + 4 MENA, N=1,089)
Sensitivity: Combined all non-CRAB-preselected including Ghaith 2017, excluding Boral 12 env isolates (k=11, N=1,077)

all_cohorts_reporting_carbapenem_incl_pr.label: All Table 4 cohorts reporting carbapenem R including CRAB-preselected (k=15, N=1,426; excludes Seleim 2022 & Alotaibi 2021 [NR] — inflated by preselected cohorts, NOT prevalence!)

carbapenem_resistance_analyses.mena_boral160_upper_bound_note: If Boral 2019's single imipenem-susceptible isolate was among the 12 environmental isolates (160/160 clinical R), MENA k=4 (N=476) weighted resistance is 96.64% vs 96.43% (159/160).

cohorts.icu_status: 154/164 (93.9%) ICU patients (50 MICU, 86 SICU, 18 burn ICU; 10 emergency service); AST includes 12 environmental isolates
cohorts.notes: 1.2% of N=172 (2/172 derived) colistin-resistant by BMD
2/40 (5.0%) colistin-resistant (isolates A119 & A140, MIC = 32 mg/L; 38/40 MIC 0.25–2 mg/L)
9/17 (52.9%) ColR by BMD (companion GERMS paper Fam, Mohamed, et al. 2020 [10.18683/germs.2020.1222] reported 9/22 [40.9%] BMD in 22 randomly selected CRAB, 7/22 [31.8%] ICU)

table4_verified_bmd_egypt_k3.note: Do NOT pool as a single ICU survey estimate without noting Abdulzahra 2018 (N=40) and Fam 2020 (N=17) were CRAB-selected while Seleim 2022 (N=100, 65% ICU) was unselected clinical A. baumannii.

additional_verified_egypt_bmd_studies_ou.setting: Fayoum University Hospital general & cardiac ICUs (pneumonia, all imipenem-R)
Egyptian CRAB comparative colistin AST study (EJMM 31[2]:63–67)
additional_verified_egypt_bmd_studies_ou.verification_status: Secondary citation (full-text PDF not in sources/; reported 100% VITEK-2 categorical agreement with BMD and high VME for disk [100%] & E-test [33%])

additional_verified_egypt_bmd_studies_ou.setting: TBRI Hospital, Giza (22 randomly selected CRAB of 32; 7/22 [31.8%] ICU)

blaOXA23_details.result: 14/17 (82.3%, PCR blaOXA-23-like); blaOXA-23 in WGS subset

blaNDM_details.result: 13/50 (26.0% in Results body vs 30% in Abstract; generic blaNDM)
4/17 (23.5%, PCR blaNDM-like); blaNDM-1 in WGS subset

mlst_studies: Ghaith et al., 2017 (Oxford 7-gene MLST on N=50: ST441 [9], ST231/IC1 [9], ST499 [8], ST208/IC2 [6], ST723 [4], ST195/IC2 [3], ST236 [2], ST1114 [1], ST945 [1], ST1089 [1], novel ST13929 [1], untypeable gdhB-null [5])
Fam, Gamal, et al., 2020 (Pasteur MLST on n=7 ColR WGS subset only: 5 ST2 + 1 ST570 [6/7 = 85.7% IC2] + 1 ST158 singleton)

mortality_summary.note: Do NOT pool into a single meta-analytic rate or label uniformly as '30-day CRAB ICU mortality': endpoints differ (in-hospital [Ballouz], 30-day all-cause [Itani], unspecified window [Boral, Alotaibi, Hafiz]) and populations differ (hospital-wide bacteremia, multicenter MDR, adult ICU MDR, hospitalized infections, ventilated ICU respiratory).

cohorts.endpoint_window: Time window NS (40.81% reported in Abstract/Results; 80/198 = 40.4% in Table 1)

cohorts.city: 7 cities (Ankara, Kayseri, Çanakkale, Istanbul, Erzurum, Izmir, Mersin)

cohorts.endpoint_window: 30-day all-cause mortality after infection onset (79/111 = 71.2% in Abstract; 79/105 = 75.2% in retained follow-up cohort; 79/99 = 79.8% in CRAB)
Time window NS (74/100 = 74.0% excluding 15 transfers in Results/Table 2; 74 deaths across N=115 [64.3%] in Tables 1 & 3)
